book.name: APOCALIPSIS
book.title: APOCALIPSIS I tsictesʌbal Jesucristo tsa' bʌ pʌsbenti Juan

content: Wucp'ejl taza but'ul bʌ ti' mich'ajel Dios
Tsa cubi wen c'am bʌ t'an loq'uem bʌ ti templo. Tsi' sube jini wuctiquil ángelob: Cucula. Beq'uela jubel ti lum i bʌl jini wucp'ejl taza but'ul bʌ ti' mich'ajel Dios, che'en.

Tsa' tili jini ñaxan bʌ ángel. Tsi' beq'ue i bʌl taza ti pañimil. Tsa' p'ojli leco jax bʌ tsoy ti jini winicob am bʌ i cha'añob i ts'ijbal jini jontol bʌ bʌte'el, jini winicob tsa' bʌ i ch'ujutesʌbeyob i yejtal.
I cha'ticlel ángel tsi' beq'ue i bʌl taza ti colem ñajb. Tsa' pʌntʌyi colem ñajb ti ch'ich' che' bajche' i ch'ich'el chʌmen bʌ winic. Tsa' chʌmi pejtelel cuxul tac bʌ am bʌ ti colem ñajb.
I yuxticlel ángel tsi' beq'ue i bʌl taza ti colem ja' tac yic'ot i loq'uib tac ja'. Tsa' pʌntʌyi ti ch'ich'.
Tsa cubibe i t'an jini ángel am bʌ ti' wenta cabʌl ja' tac. Tsi' yʌlʌ: Tojet, c Yum, añet bʌ wʌle yic'ot ti wajali. Ch'ujulet come tsa'ix a cha'le meloñel ti' tojlelob.
Come tsi' bec'beyob i ch'ich'el i cha'año' bʌ Dios yic'ot i ch'ich'el jini x'alt'añob. Wʌle tsa'ix a wʌq'ueyob i japob ch'ich'. Che'ʌch yom cha'an i mulob, che'en.
Che' jini tsa cubi t'an tsa' bʌ loq'ui ti' pulʌntib i majtan Dios. Tsi' yʌlʌ: Melel, c Yum Dios, Mach bʌ Anic i P'isol a P'ʌtʌlel. Ma' cha'len meloñel ti isujm yic'ot ti toj, che'en.
I chʌnticlel ángel tsi' beq'ue i bʌl taza ti q'uin. Tsa' aq'uenti i p'ʌtʌlel q'uin cha'an mi' pul winicob ti c'ajc.
Tsa' puliyob ti cabʌl ticwal. Tsi' p'ajbeyob i c'aba' Dios am bʌ i p'ʌtʌlel cha'an mi' yʌc' jini wocol. Ma'anic tsi' cʌyʌyob i mul cha'an mi' q'uelob ti ñuc Dios.
I jo'ticlel ángel tsi' beq'ue i bʌl taza ti' buchlib jontol bʌ bʌte'el. Tsa' ic'a i lumal i yumʌntel. Winicob x'ixicob tsi' c'uxuyob i yac' cha'an i c'uxel i wocol.
Tsi' p'ajayob Dios am bʌ ti panchan cha'an i wocol yic'ot i tsoy. Ma'anic tsi' cʌyʌyob i jontolil.
I wʌcticlel ángel tsi' beq'ue i bʌl taza ti jini ñuc bʌ colem ja' i c'aba' Eufrates. Tsa' tiqui i ya'lel cha'an mi' chajpʌbentelob i bijlel reyob ch'oyolo' bʌ ba' mi' pasel q'uin.
Tsaj q'uele: tsa' loq'ui bibi' bʌ espíritu ti' yej ajin yic'ot ti' yej jontol bʌ bʌte'el yic'ot ti' yej x'alt'an mu' bʌ i cha'len lot. Che' yilal bajche' xpequejc jini uxtiquil bibi' bʌ espíritujob.

Jini espíritujob jiñʌch xibajob mu' bʌ i pʌs tacob i yejtal i p'ʌtʌlel. Mi' majlelob ba'an reyob ti pejtelel pañimil cha'an mi' tempañob tilel ti guerra mu' bʌ caj i yujtel ti jini ñuc bʌ q'uin, i q'uiñilel Dios Mach bʌ Anic i P'isol i P'ʌtʌlel.
Awilan, talon che' bajche' xujch'. Tijicña jini woli bʌ i q'uel, woli bʌ i cʌntan i pislel ame pits'ilic mi' cha'len xʌmbal, ame quisintiquic mi' yubin che' pits'il, che'en.
Jini espíritujob tsi' tempayob tilel jini reyob ti lum, i c'aba' Armagedón ti' t'an hebreo.
I wucticlel ángel tsi' beq'ue i bʌl taza ti ic'. Tsa' loq'ui c'am bʌ t'an ti' buchlib Dios ya' ti templo am bʌ ti panchan. Tsi' yʌlʌ: Tsa'ix ujti, che'en.
Tsa' tsictiyi i xu'il chajc yic'ot ju'ucña bʌ t'an yic'ot i t'an chajc. Tsa' tili wen p'ʌtʌl bʌ yujquel lum. C'ʌlʌl ti' cajibal winicob ti pañimil ma'anic p'ʌtʌl bʌ yujquel che' bajche' jini.

Jini colem tejclum tsa' t'oxle ti uxpejt. Jini tejclum tac ti pejtelel pañimil tsa' jejmi. Dios tsi' c'ajtesʌbe i mul Babilonia. Tsi' yʌq'ue i jap jini vino am bʌ ti taza i yejtal bʌ i mich'ajel Dios.
Tsa' sʌc jili wits yic'ot lum tac joyol bʌ ti ja'. Ma'anic tsiquil ba' tsa' majli.
Tsa' yajli ti' pam winicob colem tuñija' loq'uem bʌ ti panchan. Ti jujump'ejl tuñija' an i yalel che' bajche' juncujch. Winicob tsi' p'ajayob Dios come wocol jax tsi' yubiyob cha'an tuñija'.
